dt-api.name: stateRestore.state().isActive()
dt-api.summary: Checks if the selected state is active.

type.description: Determines if the selected state is currently active or not.
type.returns: `true` if the state is active, `false` otherwise.

dt-api.description: When working with states, you might wish to know if a particular one is active. You can use `-api stateRestore.activeStates()` to get all currently active states, but if you are building a list of states for a custom UI, you might want to test each individual state. This method provides that ability.

example.title: List all states, and if they are active
